kpis.label: Average of Primary Measure
kpis.description: Average of the primary numeric measure.
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("impressions"), 2) AS average FROM srcdb."public"."report_rows"

kpis.label: Sum of Primary Measure
kpis.description: Sum of the primary numeric measure.
kpis.sql: SELECT SUM("impressions") AS total FROM srcdb."public"."report_rows"

kpis.label: Total Records
kpis.description: Total number of rows in the primary table.
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM srcdb."public"."report_rows"

kpis.label: Trend by Month
kpis.description: Primary measure summed and record count, grouped by month of the primary date dimension.
kpis.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(CAST("date" AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM("impressions") AS total, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM srcdb."public"."report_rows" GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
